```yaml
name: Claude Workflow
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  claude:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Exchange token for GitHub App token
        id: get-app-token
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: github
          scope: repo
          policy: '{"Version": "2022-10-19", "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow", "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity", "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"}, "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud": "github"}}}]}'

      - name: Setup Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: 'chore: update dependencies and build artifacts'
          author_name: github-actions[bot]
          author_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          committer_name: github-actions[bot]
          committer_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          push: true
          token: ${{ steps.get-app-token.outputs.token }}
```
